status: Editorial starting presets; not statistically fitted or validated
description: Total group effects relative to a healthy unit, not per-player values. Review replacements, normal workload and impact already in DEPI. Presets never apply automatically.

groups.label: Offensive line
groups.trigger: Two regular starters; severe: three starters, both tackles or deeper replacement losses.

groups.label: Receivers / receiving TEs
groups.trigger: Two substantial receiving roles; severe: primary targets and their usable alternatives depleted.

groups.label: Secondary
groups.trigger: Two regular coverage roles; severe: outside/slot/safety depth also depleted.

groups.label: Defensive front
groups.trigger: Multiple important edge/interior rotation players; severe: replacements also unavailable.

groups.label: Off-ball linebackers
groups.trigger: Multiple substantial off-ball roles; check coverage duties and actual replacements.

groups.label: Running backs
groups.trigger: Backfield depth depleted; severe: rushing, receiving and protection alternatives all affected.

sources.title: Position-weighted injury burden research
sources.supports: Weighting injury burden by position; does not estimate these cluster presets.

sources.title: PFF player valuation methodology
sources.supports: Role/participation context and noisy on/off comparisons; does not supply these preset values.
